name: Yenching Academy Fellowship
note: Two-year English-taught interdisciplinary master's in China Studies. Around 120 places per cohort.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (Graduate)
amount: Tuition, airfare, monthly allowance, Korean language year
dlText: Expected Feb–Mar 2027 · 2027 call not yet published

eligibility.note: Only citizens of countries in the GKS graduate guideline (about 150; Pakistan included); check the list in the official guideline

countryNotes.PK: Embassy track: watch the Korean Embassy in Islamabad for the graduate call.

note: Last cycle was announced in February with embassy applications in Feb–Mar. Apply through a Korean embassy (embassy track) or directly to a designated university (university track). Korean citizens are not eligible.

name: MEXT Research Scholarship (Embassy Recommendation)
dlText: Set by each Japanese embassy (most screen Apr–Jun) · Pakistan: expected Apr–May 2027
nominationBody: The Japanese embassy or consulate in your country

countryNotes.PK: Via the Embassy in Islamabad or the Consulate in Karachi; written exams are held in Pakistan. The 2027 round closed 26 May 2026.

note: Apply through the Japanese embassy in your country, which runs the exams and interviews. The university-recommendation (general) route is being discontinued from AY2027 at several universities, so plan on the embassy route.

name: KAIST Scholarship (International Graduate Admission)
amount: Full tuition (4 semesters MS / 8 PhD) + monthly stipend set by department/advisor + health insurance
dlText: Expected: early track ~Dec 2026, regular track ~early–mid Mar 2027 (last: 3–17 Mar 2026, 17:00 KST)
tags: Recommendation letters due before the application closes
note: Fall 2027 dates are 'TBA' on KAIST's timeline. The early track runs in December, so check in early December. Named awards (Global Presidential, Prestige) add extra stipends.

name: Tsinghua University Graduate Scholarships (CGS, university route)
amount: CGS: tuition, dorm, monthly stipend, insurance · Beijing Government Scholarship: tuition + insurance
dlText: Apply by Tsinghua's first-round deadline, mid-Dec 2026, for CGS consideration (varies by programme)

countryNotes.PK: This is separate from the HEC-nominated Chinese Government Scholarship; you can apply directly.

fields: Most fields incl. CS and engineering
note: Separate from the government-nominated (bilateral) Chinese Government Scholarship. Tsinghua picks scholarship candidates only from pre-admitted applicants; each programme catalogue lists its own dates (portal open Sep 2026 – Feb 2027).

name: Schwarzman Scholars
amount: Full scholarship (check official page for what's covered)
tags: English test if not a native speaker
fields: One-year master's in global affairs; any undergraduate major
note: Must be under 29 on 1 August of the enrolment year and finish your bachelor's before then. No specific undergraduate field required.

name: JDS Human Resource Development Scholarship (Japan)
amount: Full scholarship for a 2-year master's in Japan (check official page)
dlText: Set per country · e.g. Timor-Leste closes 20 Nov 2026; Laos tests late Jan 2027

eligibility.note: Only nationals of JDS target countries (e.g. Laos, Timor-Leste, Kyrgyz Republic, Bangladesh, Tajikistan, Maldives…); each country has its own rules

fields: Public policy, development fields set per country
note: Mostly for young government officials. Each country's JDS operating committee sets slots, age limits and dates.

name: KOICA Scholarship Program
dlText: 2027 calls are posted by each KOICA country office (dates vary)

eligibility.note: Officials from KOICA partner countries (chosen from the OECD DAC list; changes yearly)

nominationBody: Your government (via the KOICA office or Korean embassy)
note: Contact your country's KOICA office or nominating ministry for the 2027 guideline. Past Korean-government degree scholars are usually excluded.

name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
dlText: 2026/27 round closed; next round dates not announced (watch the MIS portal)
note: Needs a 2:1 (or CGPA 3.5) and an offer (conditional is fine) from a Malaysian university.

name: Thailand International Postgraduate Programme (TIPP)
dlText: Expected ~Feb 2027 (2026: 23 Feb; 2025: 31 Jan), via the Thai embassy

eligibility.note: Only nationals of countries on TICA's eligible list (includes e.g. Bangladesh, Kenya, Nepal, Pakistan, Philippines, Sri Lanka)

nominationBody: Your country's National Focal Point for development cooperation
fields: Courses listed by TICA each year
note: Apply online and send hard copies through the Royal Thai embassy.

name: KDI School Global Ambassador Scholarship
host: KDI School of Public Policy and Management
amount: Full or partial tuition; some fully funded tracks (check official page)
dlText: Fall 2027 deadline not yet announced (spring 2026 documents were due 28 Nov 2025)
note: Considered automatically when you apply. If you've already had a Korean government degree scholarship, you can't get another one for the same level here.
